user.description:
Set up Aerial Danger. Provide area patterns as YAML lists and choose source entities.

Use one single-quoted regular expression per list item so backslashes stay unchanged:

```yaml
# One regex per list item
- '\bkyiv\b'
- '\bcapital\b'
```

data_description.name: Name used for the Aerial Danger entry and device.
data_description.region_patterns: YAML list of Python regular expressions that match region-level alert text. Add one single-quoted pattern per list item.
data_description.neighborhood_patterns: YAML list of Python regular expressions that match neighborhood-level alert text. Add one single-quoted pattern per list item.
data_description.sources: Entities whose state text contains incoming alert messages.

error.invalid_pattern: One or more regex patterns are invalid.
error.invalid_pattern_format: Enter patterns as a YAML list of strings.
error.patterns_required: Enter at least one region or neighborhood pattern.
error.sources_required: Select at least one source entity.
